name: LQL-Equiv: Open-Source Software for Biologically Equivalent Dose Calculation in Radiotherapy
description: LQL-Equiv computes biologically equivalent doses in external-beam radiotherapy (BED, EQD2, NTCP by the Lyman model, and radiation-induced cancer risk by the UNSCEAR model) using the linear-quadratic-linear model, with corrections for incomplete inter-fraction repair, tumor and tissue repopulation, and treatment protraction. Standalone MATLAB GUI application used by radiation oncologists, medical physicists, researchers and educators.
